dishes.pairing_mechanics: Clean water rinses the sweet, sticky texture and refreshes after an all-night ritual; the pure-water message matches Navruz themes of renewal
dishes.physiological_impact: Thick, sticky, sweet paste; eaten after a sleepless night of cooking and singing, at dawn
dishes.fat_and_spice_profile: Sprouted wheat juice slowly cooked with flour and oil in a huge kazan through the night, stirred by women in turns; naturally sweet, thick, no added sugar

dishes.pairing_mechanics: Ice-cold still water (4-6°C) against hot fat creates a strong temperature contrast that rinses the fatty film from the tongue and resets taste between spoonfuls; clean neutral taste does not compete with cumin and carrot sweetness; sipping replaces sugary sodas at the table
dishes.physiological_impact: Very high fat load coats the palate and slows gastric emptying; salt and cumin raise thirst; post-meal heaviness and drowsiness, especially after midday wedding or Thursday osh
dishes.fat_and_spice_profile: Rice cooked in rendered lamb tail fat (dumba) and cottonseed oil, lamb or beef, yellow and red carrots, whole garlic heads, chickpeas, cumin (zira), barberry; served from a large kazan

dishes.pairing_mechanics: A cold sip after each bite gives a refreshing contrast to the hot, greasy pastry and clears crumbs and fat from the palate; the on-the-go 0.5L format matches the street-snack moment
dishes.physiological_impact: Buttery dough plus fatty filling is dense and dry; hot juice and flaky crumbs leave the mouth greasy and thirsty; common grab-and-go breakfast or snack
dishes.fat_and_spice_profile: Layered puff dough brushed with tallow or butter, filled with minced lamb, onion and lamb tail fat, black pepper and cumin; baked on tandir walls, sesame on top

framework.name: HYBRID_SPRING_RENEWAL

do: Tie freshness of spring to purity of water
voiceover.voice: Light, friendly female or young adult voice

uz: Bahor keldi - hamma narsa yangidan boshlanadi.

framework.visual_style: Soft natural daylight, pastel palette (blossom pink, fresh green, clear water blue), medium-paced cuts (1.5-2.5s), rack focus from blossoms to bottle, drone or gimbal glides through orchards and mahallas, water refracting sunlight
framework.neural_target: Combined: hippocampal memory (tradition) + dopaminergic novelty response (freshness, new beginnings)
framework.narrative_tone: Bright, optimistic, gentle energy; poetic but light
framework.primary_trigger: Renewal and purity: nature waking up, a clean start, the body shaking off winter heaviness - wrapped in family and seasonal tradition
framework.selection_rationale: Navruz is literally 'new day': renewal plus ancient tradition. Hybrid framing connects purity of water with purity of a new beginning and communal sumalak ritual.

guardrails.note: If Navruz overlaps Ramadan (e.g. 2026), Ramadan guardrails take precedence.

month_context: Women's Day (Mar 8), Navruz (Mar 21), sumalak, first blossoms

primary_event.emotional_state: Renewal, national pride, communal joy, generosity, reconciliation
cultural_rituals: Sumalak preparation through the night by women of the mahalla
Cooking ko'k somsa and ko'k chuchvara with spring greens
semiotic_symbols: Green wheat sprouts on the table
primary_event.physiological_state: Spring equinox, +12-20°C; sleepless sumalak night; festive heavy food (osh, somsa with greens, halim); more time outdoors
